question: Should OpenClaw standardize these recovery composition, final-handoff, and restored-admission contracts as RFC 0013 companion specifications before the linked core implementation work lands?
rationale: The documents deliberately create a new normative boundary between state owners and hosts; source inspection of this documentation-only branch cannot determine whether that long-term core contract is desired.

options.title: Sponsor the companion contracts
options.body: Accept the host-neutral lifecycle boundary and continue review with named owners for the snapshot and Gateway suspension seams.

options.title: Keep the material non-normative
options.body: Retain the design as external implementation evidence until a narrower core contract and ownership model are separately sponsored.

options.title: Defer the RFC addendum
options.body: Pause this proposal until the parent RFC and the linked implementation direction have an agreed landing plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the companion contracts
recommendation.body: Accept the host-neutral lifecycle boundary and continue review with named owners for the snapshot and Gateway suspension seams.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal requests this person’s review for the existing suspension contract that forms one of the two central composition boundaries.
